transcript.en: Good morning everyone, and welcome to the Museum of Farming Life.
transcript.zh: 大家早上好，欢迎来到农耕生活博物馆。

transcript.en: I understand it’s your first visit here, so I’d like to give you some background information about the museum and then explain a little about what you can see during your visit.
transcript.zh: 我知道这是你们第一次来这里，所以我想给你们讲讲一些关于博物馆的背景信息，并解释一下你们在参观期间可以看到的一些内容。

transcript.en: So, where we’re standing at the moment is the entrance to a large building that was constructed in 1880 as the home of a local businessman, Alfred Palmer, of the Palmer biscuit factory.
transcript.zh: 现在我们站的地方是一个大型建筑的入口，这个建筑在1880年建成，是本地商人，帕尔默饼干工厂的Alfred Palmer的家。

transcript.en: It was later sold and became a hall of residence for students in 1911, and a museum in 1951. In 2005, a modern extension was built to accommodate the museum’s collections.
transcript.zh: 后来它被出售并于1911年成为学生宿舍，1951年成为一座博物馆。在2005年，我们进行了现代化扩建，用于展示博物馆的藏品。

transcript.en: The museum’s owned by the university, and apart from two rooms that are our offices, the university uses the main part of the building.
transcript.zh: 博物馆由大学所有，除了两个办公室外，大学使用建筑的主要部分。

transcript.en: You may see students going into the building for lessons, but it’s not open to museum visitors, I’m afraid.
transcript.zh: 你可能会看到学生进入建筑上课，但建筑对于博物馆的参观者来说恐怕是不开放的。

transcript.en: It’s a shame because the interior architectural features are outstanding, especially the room that used to be the library.
transcript.zh: 这很可惜，因为室内的建筑特色非常出色，尤其是曾经是图书馆的那个房间。

transcript.en: Luckily, we’ve managed to keep entry to the museum free.
transcript.zh: 幸运的是，我们保持了博物馆的免费入场。

transcript.en: This includes access to all the galleries, outdoor areas and the rooms for special exhibitions.
transcript.zh: 这包括进入所有的展览馆、室外区域和特别展览的房间。

transcript.en: We run activities for children and students, such as the museum club, for which there’s no charge.
transcript.zh: 我们为儿童和学生开展活动，比如博物馆俱乐部，都不收费。

transcript.en: We do have a donation box just over there so feel free to give whatever amount you consider appropriate.
transcript.zh: 我们在那边有一个捐款箱，所以请随意捐款，任何你认为合适的金额都可以。

transcript.en: We do have a cloakroom, if you’d like to leave your coats and bags somewhere.
transcript.zh: 如果你想把外套和包放在某个地方的话，我们有一个衣帽间。

transcript.en: Unlike other museums, photography is allowed here, so you might like to keep your cameras with you.
transcript.zh: 与其他博物馆不同，这里允许拍照，所以你可以随身携带相机。

transcript.en: You might be more comfortable not carrying around heavy rucksacks, though keep your coats and jackets on as it’s quite cold in the museum garden today.
transcript.zh: 不用背着沉重的背包你可能会觉得更舒服，但是请穿着外套，因为博物馆花园里今天相当冷。

transcript.en: I’d like to tell you about the different areas of the museum.
transcript.zh: 我想讲讲关于博物馆的不同区域。

transcript.en: Just inside, and outside the main gallery, we have an area called Four Seasons.
transcript.zh: 在内部，同时在主展厅外面，有一个叫做“四季”的区域。

transcript.en: Here you can watch a four-minute animation of a woodland scene. It was designed especially for the museum by a group of young people on a film studies course, and it’s beautiful.
transcript.zh: 在这里，你可以观看一个四分钟的林地动画场景。这是由一组电影学专业的年轻人为博物馆特别设计的，非常美丽。

transcript.en: Children absolutely love it, but then, so do adults.
transcript.zh: 孩子们非常喜欢，成年人也很喜欢。

transcript.en: The main gallery’s called Town and Country.
transcript.zh: 主展厅叫做“城市与乡村”。

transcript.en: It includes a photographic collection of prizewinning sheep and shepherds. Leaving Town and Country, you enter Farmhouse Kitchen, which is … well, self-explanatory.
transcript.zh: 它包括了一个获奖摄影集——羊和牧羊人。离开“城市与乡村”后，进入农家厨房，这是...不言自明的。

transcript.en: Here we have the oldest collection of equipment for making butter and cheese in the country.
transcript.zh: 这里有国内最古老的制作黄油和奶酪的设备收藏。

transcript.en: And this morning, a specialist cheesemaker will be giving demonstrations of how it’s produced.
transcript.zh: 今天上午，一位专业的奶酪制造商将会进行示范。

transcript.en: You may even get to try some.
transcript.zh: 你甚至可以尝一些。

transcript.en: After that, you can go in two directions.
transcript.zh: 在那之后，你可以选择两个方向继续。

transcript.en: To the right is a staircase that takes you up to a landing from where you can look down on the galleries.
transcript.zh: 向右边是一条楼梯，可以带你上到一个平台，从那里你可以俯瞰展览馆。

transcript.en: To the left is a room called A Year on the Farm.
transcript.zh: 向左边是一个叫做“农场一年”的房间。

transcript.en: There’s lots of seating here as sometimes we use the room for school visits, so it’s a good place to stop for a rest.
transcript.zh: 这里有很多座位，因为有时候我们会用这个房间接待学校参观，所以这是一个休息的好地方。

transcript.en: If you’re feeling competitive, you can take our memory test in which you answer questions about things you’ve seen in the museum.
transcript.zh: 如果你比较喜欢竞争，可以参加我们的记忆测试，回答关于你在博物馆看到的事物的问题。

transcript.en: The next area’s called Wagon Walk. This contains farm carts from nearly every part of the country.
transcript.zh: 接下来的区域叫做“马车步道”。这里有来自全国各地的农用马车。

transcript.en: It’s surprising how much regional variation there was.
transcript.zh: 令人惊讶的是，各地的（马车）差异非常大。

transcript.en: Beside the carts are display boards with information about each one.
transcript.zh: 马车旁边有展板，上面有关于每个马车的信息。

transcript.en: The carts are old and fragile, so we ask you to keep your children close to you and ensure they don’t climb on the carts.
transcript.zh: 马车古老而脆弱，所以请你们带紧孩子，并确保他们不要爬上马车。

transcript.en: From Wagon Walk, you can either make your way back to reception or go out into the garden – or even go back to take another look in the galleries.
transcript.zh: 从“马车步道”，你可以返回接待处，或者走出去到花园，甚至可以回去再看一下展览馆。

transcript.en: In the far corner of the garden is Bees are Magic, but we’re redeveloping this area so you can’t visit that at the moment.
transcript.zh: 在花园远处的角落是一个叫做“魔法蜜蜂”的地方，但我们正在重新开发这个区域，所以目前无法参观。

transcript.en: You can still buy our honey in the shop, though.
transcript.zh: 不过你仍然可以在商店购买我们的蜂蜜。

transcript.en: Finally, there’s The Pond, which contains all kinds of interesting wildlife.
transcript.zh: 最后，有一个叫做“池塘”的地方，那里有各种有趣的野生动物。

transcript.en: There are baby ducks that are only a few days old, as well as tiny frogs.
transcript.zh: 有几天大的小鸭子，还有小青蛙。

transcript.en: The Pond isn’t deep and there’s a fence around it, so it’s perfectly safe for children.
transcript.zh: 池塘不深，周围有围栏，所以对孩子们来说是完全安全的。
